number: 第二百四十八条の四の二十八
summary_ja: コモディティのバケットをコモディティ・グループで定め、バケット間相関は、一方又は双方がバケット11なら0パーセント、それ以外は20パーセントとする。
summary_en: Commodity buckets are defined by commodity group; inter-bucket correlation is 0% if either bucket is number 11 and otherwise 20%.
paragraphs: The buckets for delta risk and vega risk relating to commodities shall be as set out in the following table, according to the commodity group category. {{T:p297t1}}

The correlation coefficient γ_{bc} between buckets of commodity delta risk and between buckets of vega risk shall be 0% where one or both of the buckets is bucket number 11 in the table in the preceding paragraph, and 20% in all other cases.

sections_en.第三節 第二款 第七目: Buckets, Risk Factors, Sensitivities, Risk Weights and Correlations for Commodities
